h1: Custom 44 Inch Umbrellas for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 44 inch umbrellas in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Custom 44 inch umbrellas offer a generous canopy that keeps two people dry during heavy rain, making them ideal for client gifts or employee appreciation programs. The larger size provides better coverage than standard compact umbrellas, and you can imprint your logo on the canopy or handle with screen printing or digital transfer. Choose from auto-open or manual styles in nylon or pongee fabric for a polished, professional look.
heroAltText: Group of custom 44 inch umbrellas with company logos, open and showing large canopy
